source: Door markers from json.tarkov.dev lighthouse locks, colored by key-legend.json in the Lighthouse v1 pack. Lighthouse.svg defines .locked but no element uses it, so these are markers only. Eight locks share the Factory emergency exit key; that grouping is kept as published and may need a raid check. The last four rows are the extract and transit colors painted on the overview, not door keys.
